Incredibly Expensive and Lacking Authentic Quality
May 2020
My boyfriend and I came here for a date night, and we were extremely disappointed. I have eaten a lot of authentic Persian and Lebanese food, and this restaurant does not represent their cuisine. My boyfriend ordered the Lamb Chops. They were extremely over cooked, to the point he could not chew it. We sent it back to be recooked again. It was cooked better the next time, but we both had to eat my meal while they cooked it. My chicken was also over cooked and quite dry, almost as if they don't marinate the chicken but simply rub the spice on as they cook. I was really looking forward to the charcoal bbq taste, but I was too distracted by the dry chicken to enjoy it. The french fries are store bought frozen and the salad was unremarkable. The only redeeming item was the hummus, however the pita bread they served with it was stale. This was one of the most expensive meals we have had in Hanoi, and the quality was not there. We will not be returning.

Beirut
Nov 2019 • Friends
I went with my friend for the first time in a Lebanese restaurant- we didn't regret it. The place is so classy, the design and decorations are great. The restaurant has very accommodating staffs and employees. They'll all give you a big smile. Both the local and foreign staffs are friendly and all of them seems amicable. They do make great shisha. Had our first shisha here, and it was well-made by their staff (As far as I remember, he is the filipino staff-Denver,I think is his name). Had a great time drinking plus talking with the staffs.

Ps. This restaurant do have great dancer, also. She's so graceful. ☺
